root_cause: The test simulating an old host copied the gate process environment and therefore inherited ECT_Q256_LAUNCHER_IN_SANDBOX=1. It exercised the real inside-sandbox path instead of its mocked host bootstrap.
corrective_action: Explicitly remove ECT_Q256_LAUNCHER_IN_SANDBOX from the simulated host environment, rerun the launcher unit suite locally, recommit, and regenerate the complete Role E gate.
reuse_policy: The FAIL receipt is negative evidence only and cannot authorize any launch.
